_about: Label rates read from the PCPB-approved label PDFs linked from https://www.pcpb.go.ke/crops/ (register table of 24 Aug 2026). Each use quotes the label. phiDays and reiHours are the LONGER of the label and the register value. Products whose label could not be read unambiguously are listed in 'unverified' and show 'See the label' in the app. Never hand-edit a rate without a quote.
